channel.title: Shankar Saini | Field Notes
channel.description: Short, practical SEO and web development notes by Shankar Saini, Jaipur.

item.title: Core Web Vitals: the three numbers worth fixing first
item.author: shankarsaini8107@gmail.com (Shankar Saini)
item.description: Fix LCP, INP and CLS in order of how much they hurt real visitors, and ignore the rest of the noise until they are green.

item.title: Title tags: still the strongest on-page lever
item.author: shankarsaini8107@gmail.com (Shankar Saini)
item.description: One line of HTML decides how you look in search results and tells Google what the page is about.

item.title: Meta descriptions don't rank, but they still earn clicks
item.author: shankarsaini8107@gmail.com (Shankar Saini)
item.description: Not a ranking factor, yet a better description can be the difference between a scroll-past and a click.

item.title: Canonical, 301 or noindex: which one to use
item.author: shankarsaini8107@gmail.com (Shankar Saini)
item.description: Three tools that look similar and solve three different problems. Gone = 301, duplicate = canonical, private = noindex.

item.title: Local SEO for a small business: the boring basics that work
item.author: shankarsaini8107@gmail.com (Shankar Saini)
item.description: Nearby customers find you through a handful of unglamorous things done consistently.

item.title: Schema markup: only mark up what people can see
item.author: shankarsaini8107@gmail.com (Shankar Saini)
item.description: Structured data helps search engines understand a page, but only if it matches reality.

item.title: Don't hide your content behind JavaScript animations
item.author: shankarsaini8107@gmail.com (Shankar Saini)
item.description: A scroll-reveal that starts at opacity 0 looks great, until the script fails and the page is blank.

item.title: WordPress and Shopify: five settings I check before anything else
item.author: shankarsaini8107@gmail.com (Shankar Saini)
item.description: Before touching keywords, check that the platform is not quietly working against the site.

item.title: Images: the fastest speed win on most sites
item.author: shankarsaini8107@gmail.com (Shankar Saini)
item.description: On most pages I audit, images are the biggest download. Fixing them moves LCP more than anything else.
